The task is finished — the memo was submitted and accepted, so there's nothing further to request or wait on. Here's the wrap-up.

## DE GL 1000 – March 2026 bank rec: done

**Why book and bank disagreed (€14,908.50):**

| Item | Amount | Nature | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Duplicate Rheinbyte payment (JE‑00273 vs JE‑00272; bank shows one debit) | €6,480.00 | Book error | Reversed → **JE‑00309**, support DOC‑0165 + DOC‑0202 |
| Bank service charge not booked (BT‑DE‑0053) | €38.50 | Book omission | Posted → **JE‑00310** (Dr 6900 / Cr 1000), support DOC‑0202 |
| Kessler AG RE‑7090 receipt after bank cut‑off (JE‑00308) | €18,200.00 | Deposit in transit | Left as timing item; remittance DOC‑0206 supports it |
| SEPA OUT REF TX‑44817 (BT‑DE‑0045) | €3,150.00 | Unsupported bank debit | **Not booked** — flagged as **EXC‑001** |

**Reconciliation after adjustments**
- Bank €342,467.86 + DIT €18,200.00 = **€360,667.86**
- Book €363,817.86 (verified in GL after entries)
- Remaining gap = **€3,150.00**, entirely the open TX‑44817 item.

**Other housekeeping:** 18 of 19 bank lines matched 1:1 to ledger entries; the €6,480 reversal is ≈ USD 7,128 at the March policy rate (1.10), so no controller approval was required; DE "Bank reconciliations" checklist set to *in_progress* pending the exception and the payroll account.

**Needs your attention:** EXC‑001 — treasury/bank must identify the payee of the €3,150 SEPA transfer so it can be booked with support (or recalled if unauthorized). I'd also suggest a look at the AP control that let the same invoice be posted twice on consecutive days.
